component.name: NAM Audio Pipe
component.summary: Low-latency PipeWire standalone host for Neural Amp Modeler

description.p: NAM-Audio-Pipe is an ultra-low latency, real-time standalone PipeWire host application for Neural Amp Modeler (NAM) simulation on Linux, engineered in pure Rust with strict real-time safety.

ul.li: Direct native PipeWire integration (libpipewire-0.3) at low quantum buffer sizes down to 64 samples (1.33 ms).
Embedded NeuralAmpModeler-rs v4.0.0 DSP engine supporting WaveNet (A1/A2), LSTM, ConvNet, Linear FIR, and Sequential topologies in standard .nam and binary .namb v2 formats.
Strict real-time safety: zero heap allocations, zero mutex locks, and zero blocking calls on the audio loop.

Exclusive cabinet slot supporting partitioned UPOLS convolution for .wav IRs (32–256 sample partitions) or unity-gain .nam/.namb neural cabinets, with constant-latency --cab-bypass and configurable --ir-level-policy.
PipeWire SPA latency reporting with live graph feedback and exact sample delay compensation.
Concurrent asynchronous 32-bit float stereo WAV recording powered by Linux io_uring with pre-allocated slot pools, 4 GiB auto-split, and selectable noise gate modes (silence or musical).
Half-band polyphase anti-aliasing oversampling (2× and 4×), adaptive compute auto-slimming under CPU pressure, dBu input/output calibration, and optional playback-only output clamping.
Hardware-accelerated SIMD AVX2/FMA baseline vectorization (x86-64-v3) with Profile-Guided Optimization (PGO) and LLVM BOLT code reordering.

screenshot.caption: NAM Audio Pipe interactive terminal status display and PipeWire host monitor

ul.li: Integrated NeuralAmpModeler-rs v4.0.0 core DSP engine with WaveNet head support and updated linear prewarm calibration.
Expanded cabinet slot support for WAV, .nam, and .namb payloads with --cab-bypass and explicit --ir-level-policy modes (peak-normalized, preserved, legacy-nam-plugin).
Added optional musical noise gate (--gate-mode), input calibration flags (--calibrate-input, --input-calibration-level), and --output-mode selection.
Playback-only --output-limit safety clamp for interactive PipeWire monitoring without altering offline captures, plus Freedesktop Platform 26.08 migration.
